description:
JGoodies Forms 1.2.1's FormLayout API on top of SwingBridge Emulators, so a
        migrated application keeps compiling after rewriting its com.jgoodies imports to
        vaadinx.jgoodies. A BSD-licensed fork of the upstream sources with the pixel layout
        engine replaced by one emitting CSS Grid. Starter prototype: shipped as-is at the
        coverage it has.
